text:
Jordan (AE): Quick sync - need to lock preflight POC gates for Acme. They're asking for explicit acceptance criteria across latency, cost, and quality before legal signs off. Can we align and call out owners?

Aisha (Account): +1. Customer timeline: wants a 3-week trial starting next Monday. Major blocker: security questionnaire outstanding (KMS + VPC).

Priya (Solutions Eng): Here's what I'd propose for success gates (draft):
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for 64-token completions (api route: /v1/generate with model=vX).
- Cost: average cost/request <= $0.20 for their expected prompt mix (we'll estimate burn).
- Quality: >= 90% pass rate on a 120-prompt eval set (human-reviewed pass/fail).
- Security: KMS integration validated, traffic restricted to their VPC, data retention TTL agreed.

Sam (SRE): For latency targets, hosted baseline may be ~300-400ms p95 for their dataset. Dedicated nodes with batching tuned drop to ~150-200ms. We should clarify whether they require hosted or dedicated for acceptance.

Jordan (AE): They said "production-like" perf but open to dedicated if price makes sense. Also asked about fallback routing in case capacity spikes.

Alex (Pricing): Two pricing options to offer in POC:
1) Hosted trial: usage billed at standard hosted rates + credits. No commit, variable burn.
2) Short-term dedicated reservation: 1-week reserved capacity (minimum) with reduced per-request rate. I'll run numbers but rough estimate: dedicated reduces per-request unit cost ~30%-40% for high throughput.

Priya (Solutions Eng): On evals - I'll own building the 120-prompt eval set (mix of short completion, mult-turn chat, and edge-case prompts). Example prompts we'll include:
```
1) "Summarize the following paragraph in one sentence."
2) "Extract the company name and city from this invoice text."
3) A multi-turn customer support thread requiring context carryover.
```
We should define pass/fail rules (exact match where required, fuzzy scoring allowed for summarization, and manual review for safety).

EvalBot: Preliminary automated pass-rate on a small probe (20 prompts) against current hosted model: 86% pass. Median latency (hosted) 310ms, p95 520ms. Dedicated sim (local) median 170ms, p95 240ms.

Aisha (Account): Security Qs from Acme:
- Do you support customer KMS (bring-your-own-key)?
- Can we deploy in a private VPC / peering?
- What are retention & delete guarantees for PII?
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence request.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Answers:
- KMS BYOK: yes, supported on Private deployments; hosted requires a contract to enable customer-managed keys (verify with security).
- Private VPC: Private deployment or Dedicated with VPC peering possible.
- Retention: configurable TTL, can set to 0 for trial; we'll document delete flow.
- Compliance: we have SOC2 Type II and ISO artifacts - I'll pull the kit.

Sam (SRE): Action item: I'll run a quick dedicated perf test with their prompt distribution on our staging infra tomorrow 9am PT and post numbers. Need sample prompt distribution + tokens per response.

Alex (Pricing): Action item: I'll build a 1-week dedicated vs hosted cost comparison and include estimated burn for their traffic profile. Need QPS estimate from Acme to finalize.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Action item: I'll produce the 120-prompt eval set and a scoring rubric by EOD Friday. Also propose an automated CI job to run the eval daily during the trial and surface regressions to their team + ours.

Aisha (Account): I'll push for security QA answers and KMS doc. Also will request their expected QPS and a sample of real prompts (anonymized).

Jordan (AE): Can we get an agreed acceptance checklist we can hand to the customer with explicit owners & timeboxes? Suggest:
- Day 0: Kickoff, SOW & contact list.
- Day 1-3: Security questionnaire + KMS/VPC confirmation.
- Day 4-7: Deploy dedicated (if chosen) + initial perf run.
- Day 8-14: Run eval set, iterate prompts, tune batching/quantization.
- Day 15-21: Final acceptance, handoff to customer ops.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a one-page acceptance checklist and post here by tomorrow. Example acceptance criteria we'll include verbatim (for contract):
"Acceptance requires p95 latency <= 250ms for 64-token completions on the agreed model variant, average cost/request <= $0.20, and >= 90% pass rate on the agreed 120-prompt eval set, subject to normal traffic variance and documented test harness."

Sam (SRE): Note: need to add a warmup plan for KV cache and prefix caching to avoid cold-start spikes during tests. We'll also define a 10% tolerance window for network noise during official measurement windows.

EvalBot: After dedicated perf run (simulated): median latency 165ms, p95 225ms; automated pass-rate on 120-prompt dry run 88% (need human review to reach target).

Jordan (AE): Great. Next steps: Priya to post checklist, Sam to run perf and post logs, Alex to send pricing matrix, Aisha to chase security answers and customer QPS. I'll consolidate and send to Acme by EOD Monday.

Aisha (Account): I'll also ask legal for a short-term addendum template to enable BYOK for the trial if needed.

Jordan (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: - flagging this as high priority. If anything blocks the timeline call it out here.

Priya (Solutions Eng): noted. Will post the draft acceptance checklist here when ready.

Sam (SRE): I'll share perf run artifacts in #eng-runtime but will drop the summary here too.

Alex (Pricing): Sending draft numbers in this thread later today.

EvalBot: Logging automated job: /evals/run 1717601111 - scheduled daily during trial.

Jordan (AE): Perfect - closing the loop.
